plainStatement: Rows (a), (b) and (c) are ALREADY GREEN on the baseline: U19b (920630bc0) installs the campaign stream's genesis branch and effective head on its first append, so the baseline resolver, which reads the effective branch record and then the journal revision on it, answers the journal head after one append and advances with the second. They are kept as pins. The unit's red is row (d): a campaign whose journal holds events but whose effective head is missing is answered no-authoritative-stream on the baseline, which the launch route turns into an ungated launch of a journaled campaign (CO3 F1). The unit's change is the rule (existence read from the journal, head read through the correction lease seam, a missing effective head refused) plus the comment correction.
